svg.title: The route — experience timeline
svg.desc: AUG 2024: SRM IST — Starts B.Tech CSE. CGPA 9.35.; 2025: DOP-XML — IEEE paper; ACM IKDD at IISER Pune & IIIT Bangalore.; JUN 2026: DELOITTE — AI & Data Intern: multi-agent systems, RAG, AWS.; AUG 2026: LOGIC PLAY — Technical Head. Ran VibeX; judged Stack Roulette.; SEP 2026: SENSORA 2.0 — Best Implementation winner with SurgeGuard.; OCT 2026: PROMPT INJECTION — Two-stage ML guard for LLM agents.
